source.note: hand-written; an explicit 'remember this' note, including a secret that must not be stored

units.text: Remember this. Gym locker is two fourteen, the combination is, no, actually don't store the combination, just the locker number, two fourteen.
Dentist is Doctor Lewandowska, the practice on Półwiejska, next check-up is in six months so, March. She said the lower left molar, the one with the old filling, needs watching.
I'm allergic to penicillin, I keep forgetting to tell new doctors, so, that, remember that. Amoxicillin too, same family.
Parking at work: level minus two, the spots by the lift are the company's, anything else gets a ticket, learned that the expensive way in August, a hundred and fifty złoty.

expected.content: The user's gym locker is number 214 (the combination is deliberately not recorded).
The user's dentist is Dr. Lewandowska at the practice on Półwiejska; the next check-up is in March 2027, and the lower left molar with an old filling needs watching.
The user is allergic to penicillin and amoxicillin.
At work the user must park on level -2 in the spots by the lift (the company's); parking elsewhere got a 150 PLN ticket in August 2026.
